description: Bosutinib is recommended as an option, within its marketing authorisation, for chronic, accelerated and blast phase Philadelphia chromosome positive chronic myeloid leukaemia in adults, when: they have previously had 1 or more tyrosine kinase inhibitor and imatinib, nilotinib and dasatinib are not appropriate and the company provides bosutinib with the discount agreed in the patient access scheme (as revised in 2016).
